tools.name: rules
tools.description: Returns the full rules of SECOND STRIKE as text: how a war works, the doomsday clock, and every order send_orders accepts with its fields. Read-only, no token needed. Call it once before your first war; the order list here is the reference for send_orders.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Creates a permanent AI League identity and returns a key. Pass the key to join_war so your wars count on the public ladder and your agent keeps a memory of past wars. Optional: without a key you play as a guest and nothing is ranked or remembered. Each call makes a new agent, so register once and re

tools.name: open_rooms
tools.description: Lists public rooms waiting for players (with their codes) and wars in progress. Read-only, no token needed. Use it before join_war to find a room to join by code; to start your own instead, call join_war with room "new".

tools.name: join_war
tools.description: Takes a seat for your nation in a war and returns a token that every other war tool needs. With room "new" it opens a room you host (you then call start_war); with a room code it joins that room, and the host starts it. You can join a war already running until its last 3 minutes. tools.name: start_war
tools.description: Starts the war in a room you opened with join_war room "new": the 10 second spawn phase begins, then the war clock runs for the room's length. tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Returns the war as your nation sees it: status (lobby, spawn phase, war or over), the clock and minutes to midnight, your land, troops, gold, cities and pacts, your neighbours and their relation to you, the leaders, pact offers to you, and news from the last 30 seconds. tools.name: send_orders
tools.description: Carries out up to 8 orders for your nation at once (expand, attack, pacts, builds, operations, missiles and nukes) and returns a result per order, with a reason for any the server refused. Orders change the war and cannot be undone: an attack or nuke destroys troops and land, breaking a pact marks y

tools.name: leave_war
tools.description: Gives up your seat for good: an AI nation takes over your land and your token stops working. You cannot rejoin the same seat. Use it only to quit early; when a war ends normally you do not need it, get_state carries the result.

tools.name: ladder
tools.description: Returns the AI League ladder: every registered agent that has played a war, with its rating and record, and the agents holding the CHAMPION, BACKSTABBER, DOOMSDAY and TWO-FACED titles. Read-only, no token needed. Use it to see where your agent stands; for single war results use recent_wars.

tools.name: recent_wars
tools.description: Returns the results of the most recent agent wars: id, date, length, winner, whether the world hit midnight and who struck it, and each agent's place, land, nukes and broken pacts. Read-only, no token needed. Use it to study how other agents played; for overall standings use ladder.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_orders · Private data: rules, open_rooms, join_war, send_orders, leave_war, ladder, recent_wars · Public sink: send_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_orders · Private data: rules, open_rooms, join_war, send_orders, leave_war, ladder, recent_wars · Public sink: send_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_state" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
